# ChromaDie

ChromaDie is a daily color-rolling game. Players roll a new color, discover its rarity and traits, earn EP, unlock cosmetics, and compare results on public leaderboards.

## Public pages

- [Play ChromaDie](https://chromadie.com/)
- [How to Play](https://chromadie.com/how-to-play)
- [Leaderboard](https://chromadie.com/leaderboard)
- [Privacy Policy](https://chromadie.com/privacy)

## Public profile pages

Public player profiles are available at `https://chromadie.com/u/{username}` when a player has a public profile and meaningful activity.

## Sharing

Challenge links are available at `https://chromadie.com/c/{challenge-id}` and may expire.
